product_metadata.title: Cutting board for Convection Toaster Oven, Compatible with Ninja DT201/DT251 Foodi Air Fryer, with Heat Resistant Non-Skid Silicone Feet, Creates Storage Space, Protects Cabinets Cupboard, 16.3x13.1”
features: Bamboo cutting board sitting on Convection Toaster Oven (Oven Excluded) : Designed to be compatible with DT201 / DT251. Sits steadily on the oven, protects cabinets from being damaged and protects family and pets from getting hurt by heat.
Heat Resistant and Non-Skid Feet: 4 silicone feet raise the cutting board 0.4" off the oven, create an airflow channel to avoid overheat damage to the oven and also keep the board steady, no sliding.
Reclaim Counter Space: Creates extra room over hot oven to store accessories such as mitts, liners, pans, bread baskets, etc.
Durable Cutting and Serving Tray: A solid cutting board, also a serving tray at hand for fresh hot cookies, bread coming off the oven. The side handles make it easy to grab.

Wonderful gift for any family using smart ovens on daily basis. It might be compatible with other oven models: The dimension enclosed by 4 silicone feet is 14.7 *11.5”, please measure your oven surface and make sure all 4 feet could sit on it.
